map.输入已完成重量与重复次数，使用多种经典公式估算一次最大重复重量 1RM，适用于力: Enter the completed weight and repetitions and use several classic formulas to estimate the one-repetition maximum 1RM, suitable for strength-training program design.
map.力量训练者用次最大重量推估 1RM，避免直接冲大重量试举受伤。: Strength trainers use submaximal weight to estimate 1RM, avoiding direct heavy lifts and injury.
map.周期训练中定期复测 1RM，量化力量增长、调整训练负荷。: In periodic training, retest 1RM regularly to quantify strength gain and adjust load.
map.按 1RM 百分比安排强度（如 80% 做 5–6 次、90% 做 2–3 次）: Arrange intensity by 1RM percentage (e.g. 80% for 5-6 reps, 90% for 2-3 reps).
map.可复现算例：100 kg × 5 次推估 1RM: Reproducible example: 100 kg x 5 reps to estimate 1RM
map.：输入：重量 100 kg、次数 5。\nEpley=100×(1+5/30)=:
: input: weight 100 kg, reps 5.
Epley = 100 x (1 + 5/30) = 116.7 kg; Brzycki = 100 / (1.0278 - 0.0278 x 5) = 100 / 0.8888 = 112.5 kg; Lombardi = 100 x 5^0.10 = 100 x 1.1746 = 117.5 kg; Mayhew = 100 x 100 / (52.2 + 41.9 x e^(-0.055 x 5)) = 100 x 100 / (52.2 + 31.82) = 119.0 kg.
average 1RM = (116.7 + 112.5 + 117.5 + 119.0) / 4 approx 116.4 kg.
Conclusion: this single-rep max is about 116 kg; training can use 80% approx 93 kg for 5-6 reps, 90% approx 105 kg for 2-3 reps.
map.四个公式哪个最准？: Which of the four formulas is most accurate?
map.Epley 最常用且在 reps≤10 较准；Brzycki 与之接近；Lomb: Epley is most common and accurate for reps<=10; Brzycki is close; Lombardi is conservative; Mayhew is more stable for more reps. Averaging smooths single-formula bias, but all are only estimates.
map.能做几次最准？: How many times gives the most accurate result?
map.1–10 次内估算可靠，次数越多误差越大；rep 越少（如 3 次）越接近真实: Estimation is reliable within 1-10 reps; more reps mean larger error; fewer reps (e.g. 3) are closer to true 1RM. This tool limits reps to 1-12; beyond that, measure at lower reps or lower expectations.
